rationale.conceptual: The method involves an established but non-trivial quantum chemical workflow: transition state search with effective core potentials and polarization functions, followed by MP2 energy and thermochemical corrections. It requires careful implementation beyond simple textbook operations.
rationale.execution: The pipeline spans ~6 stages: input preparation, geometry optimization/TS search, frequency confirmation, MP2 single-point calculation, thermochemical correction, and data extraction. It depends on the GAMESS external tool, which is standard but adds orchestration complexity.

difficulty.reasoning: The task requires reproducing a standard quantum chemical transition state search and energy calculation using GAMESS. The method (RHF with SBK ECPs, MP2 single-point, Mulliken charges) is established but non-trivial to set up correctly. The pipeline is a multi-stage workflow with a specialized tool, but no GPU is needed and resources are modest.

compute_estimate.reasoning: The system is a small transition-metal complex with ~20 atoms, computed at RHF/MP2 with effective core potentials; typical CPU-only run requires modest memory (few GB) and negligible input data.
